test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 28 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A and B working alone can do a work in 40 days and 30 days, respectively. They started the work together, but B left after some time and A finished the remaining work in 5 days. How many days after starting did B leave the work?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Work (LCM of 40, 30) = 120 units.

Efficiency of **A** = 120 ÷ 40 = 3 units/day; Efficiency of **B** = 120 ÷ 30 = 4 units/day.

Work done by **A** alone in the last 5 days = 3 × 5 = 15 units.

Work done by **A** and **B** together = 120 − 15 = 105 units.

Number of days **B** worked = 105 ÷ (3 + 4) = 105 ÷ 7 = 15 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 15 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Time taken by **A** = 40 days, Time taken by **B** = 30 days. **A** worked alone for the last 5 days.

**Formula:** Total Work = Efficiency × Time

⇒ Let **B** leave after **x** days. Both worked together for **x** days.

⇒ Work done in **x** days = (Efficiency of **A** + Efficiency of **B**) × **x**

⇒ Remaining work done by **A** in 5 days = 3 × 5 = 15 units

⇒ Total work = 7 × **x** + 15 = 120

⇒ 7**x** = 120 − 15

⇒ 7**x** = 105

⇒ **x** = 15 days

**∴ The correct answer is 15 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Work Concept

Total work is always assumed to be the **LCM** of the number of days taken by individuals to ensure efficiencies are whole numbers.

Efficiency Calculation

Efficiency = **Total Work** ÷ **Time**. It represents the amount of work done in a single unit of time (1 day/1 hour).

Leaving and Joining

In problems where a person leaves, always calculate the work done by the remaining person(s) during the period they worked alone first.</p
